title: All session and proof data readable by anyone holding the URL (unauthenticated bearer-capability model, no expiry/revocation observed)
user: Learner sharing a proof link; anyone the link leaks to
devpost_criterion: Technical execution / trust & safety of the proof claims
prerequisites: A valid session URL (e.g. created via 'Use the sample lesson')
steps: Create a session at /new (sample lesson) and complete any step
Copy the session URL; open /api/sessions/<id> and /api/sessions/<id>/events in a fresh browser context with no cookies or credentials
Observe full learner claim, prediction, confidence, belief-test structure, artifact hashes and event chain returned as JSON
Open /proof/<id> and download the signed proof bundle and repaired notebook without any auth challenge
expected: Some authorization, expiry, or at minimum an in-product warning that links grant full read access
actual: Zero authentication on every route and API; URL holder reads everything including the learner's raw claim text, confidence, and signed artifacts; no delete/expire affordance observed

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: GET /api/sessions/session_522276e6-975b-4c54-aa65-266545b035db returned full session incl. learnerClaim with no credentials

evidence.label: Directly observed
evidence.detail: GET /api/sessions/<id>/events returned hash-chained event log with internal event kinds

evidence.label: Observed in generated artifact
evidence.detail: Proof bundle JSON downloaded unauthenticated from /proof/<id> (34,841 bytes, valid signature block)

evidence.label: Unverified
evidence.detail: Session expiry reportedly >=6h server-side; no expiry observable within the audit window

likely_cause: Deliberate no-account design: session ID in URL is the only capability; no auth layer implemented on Worker routes
unverified: Whether any server-side expiry or access logging exists; whether live-notebook (non-sample) sessions add any guard
learner_impact: A shared or leaked link permanently exposes the learner's verbatim 'before' reasoning and confidence; learner may not understand links are public-read
judge_impact: A security-minded evaluator will flag the absence of any access control or expiry story, even if acceptable for a demo
trust_impact: Moderate: the product's proof narrative implies controlled sharing, but any link holder reads everything forever
recommended_correction: Document the capability-URL model in the UI; add session expiry and a delete/forget affordance; separate proof IDs from session IDs; add an interstitial warning before first share/download
smallest_correction: Add a visible 'Anyone with this link can view this session' label on session and proof pages
acceptance_criteria: UI states the bearer-link model; sessions expire or are deletable; proof and session IDs are distinct capabilities
regression_test: Automated: create session, read it unauthenticated (expect 200 while valid), delete it, expect 404 afterwards
score_leverage: Medium — converts a silent risk into an explicit, defensible design choice judges can credit

title: Learner free text stored verbatim and embedded into HMAC-signed proof bundles with no length/content limits (stored-XSS latent; content-integrity gap)
journey: Question -> Prediction -> Boundary -> Apply -> Repair -> Proof
user: Learner (or anyone scripting the session API)
devpost_criterion: Technical execution / trustworthiness of signed artifacts
environment: Production Cloudflare Worker; sample-lesson mode verified; live mode not tested
prerequisites: Create a session; type arbitrary text into 'Your claim' and 'Your revised mental model'
steps: Submit claim containing , , , {{7*7}}, ${7*7}, javascript:void(0), ../../etc/passwd,
Complete the loop to /proof/<id>
Download the proof record; inspect beliefTest.learnerClaim, learnerRevision.text, reasoningDiff.dimensions
Confirm via /api/sessions/<id> that text is stored verbatim with no sanitization or length cap (360 chars accepted; no maxlength observed)
expected: Server-side length cap and content normalization; signed artifacts treat learner text as untrusted data (or store hash-only)
actual: Text stored and signed verbatim; safety relies entirely on client-side escaping (which currently works on all observed surfaces); repaired notebook correctly excludes learner text

evidence.label: Reproduced
evidence.detail: All payloads rendered as literal text on Question/Prediction/Apply/Proof/Reasoning-Diff surfaces

evidence.label: Observed in network response
evidence.detail: learnerClaim verbatim in /api/sessions/<id> JSON incl. <script> and traversal strings

evidence.label: Observed in generated artifact
evidence.detail: Payloads present verbatim in signed bundle fields beliefTest.learnerClaim and learnerRevision.text

evidence.label: Observed in generated artifact
evidence.detail: Repaired .ipynb contains none of the payload strings (grep-verified) — correct isolation

evidence.label: Could not test
evidence.detail: ~1500-char input: browser_input tooling capped at ~300 chars/call; 360 chars accepted without error

likely_cause: No ingest validation beyond presence checks; React default escaping is the only output defence; bundle signer includes learner text by design
unverified: Live-mode GPT path may introduce additional rendering surfaces (LLM-generated echoes) not reachable with sample lesson; exact server-side max length if any
learner_impact: None today (no script execution); learner content is permanently embedded in downloadable signed bundles
judge_impact: Evaluator sees a single-layer XSS defence and unsigned-content-policy gap in a product whose pitch is integrity
trust_impact: Signed 'proof' documents can carry arbitrary/offensive learner text with a valid product signature, diluting what the signature vouches for
recommended_correction: Enforce server-side length cap (e.g. 1000 chars) and control-character rejection; keep raw storage but hash-or-flag learner text in bundles; add a bundle field distinguishing 'learner-supplied, unverified' content
smallest_correction: Add maxlength + server-side length validation on claim and revision fields
acceptance_criteria: Claims >cap rejected with a clear error; bundle marks learner text as unverified input; no render path uses innerHTML for learner text
regression_test: Submit payload battery each release; assert escaped rendering on all surfaces and cap enforcement at API level
score_leverage: Medium — cheap hardening that directly strengthens the integrity story
